title: Meta's Muse AI Agent Comes to Instagram DMs
excerpt: Meta today expanded what Muse can do in Instagram, making the personal AI agent more useful. Muse can organize the Instagram content you save into...
content_html:
Tuesday November 24, 2026 2:12 pm PST by Juli Clover

Meta today expanded what Muse can do in Instagram, making the personal AI agent more useful.


Muse can organize the Instagram content you save into collections or travel itineraries, plus it can make grocery lists for recipes you find. Meta says you can also chat with Muse in DMs to learn more about a post or catch up on what you've missed.

When saving a post on Instagram, users in the U.S. and Canada will see an option to have Muse organize their posts. Muse in DMs will show up as a standard conversation.

As TechCrunch points out, Muse for Instagram DMs lets users chat with the AI agent without having to switch from Instagram to the Muse app and back again. Conversations with Muse on Instagram will also appear as a side chat in the Muse app.

Muse won't make changes or take actions without user permission. Muse support for Instagram DMs is rolling out in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Japan, and Singapore starting today.

Monday November 9, 2026 1:55 pm PST by Juli Clover

Meta today updated the Muse app for iOS to add Apple Watch support, which means Muse users can access the proactive AI agent from the watch. The app adds the Muse character to the watch with an option to text it, dictate text to it, or call it. There's also a Muse complication for quick access. Meta's Muse Personal AI Agent Launches in the UK

Tuesday November 24, 2026 3:15 am PST by Tim Hardwick

Meta has rolled out its Muse personal AI agent to users in the United Kingdom.
